# Dealer AI Visibility

> Dealer AI Visibility is a free, evidence-based scan showing how well public dealership website signals support discovery and accurate interpretation by AI systems.

Operator: Dealer Growth Hackers
Canonical URL: https://dealeraivisibility.com/
Commercial ecosystem: https://dealershipmcp.com/
Deeper website analysis: https://dealeraeoaudit.com/

## What the scan measures

- AI crawler access
- Structured dealership meaning
- Citability and answer-ready content
- Technical website health
- Authority and experience signals
- Brand connections across public sources

Scores are directional diagnostics, not guarantees that any AI platform will rank, cite, or recommend a dealership.
